DNS Records for 3tched.com Mail Server
======================================

Container IP: 10.149.181.121
(Replace with your public IP if accessing from internet)

1. A Record (Mail Server)
--------------------------
Type: A
Name: mail
Value: 10.149.181.121
TTL: 3600

2. MX Record (Mail Exchange)
-----------------------------
Type: MX
Name: @
Value: mail.3tched.com
Priority: 10
TTL: 3600

3. SPF Record (Sender Policy Framework)
----------------------------------------
Type: TXT
Name: @
Value: v=spf1 mx ~all
TTL: 3600

4. DMARC Record
---------------
Type: TXT
Name: _dmarc
Value: v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:admin@3tched.com
TTL: 3600

5. DKIM Record (ACTUAL - Generated by Maddy)
---------------------------------------------
Type: TXT
Name: default._domainkey
Value: v=DKIM1; k=rsa; 
TTL: 3600

Testing
-------
After DNS propagation (can take up to 48 hours, usually minutes):

1. Test MX record:
   dig MX 3tched.com

2. Test SPF:
   dig TXT 3tched.com

3. Test DKIM:
   dig TXT default._domainkey.3tched.com

4. Send test email to:
   https://www.mail-tester.com/

5. Check DKIM/SPF/DMARC:
   https://mxtoolbox.com/

Note: For internal testing, you don't need public DNS - just use the IP directly.
